name: mathmodel-studio
description: Mathematical modeling workbench with joint case and question retrieval, evidence-led writing, figures, scoring, and review workflows.

interface.shortDescription: 数学建模竞赛论文生产流程：审题、建模、终审，五幕走完一篇可提交的论文
interface.longDescription: A multi-runtime mathematical modeling workbench with case and question-level retrieval across CUMCM, the China Graduate Mathematical Contest in Modeling, and Huashu Cup, plus stage packs, dynamic paper plans, figure evidence contracts, claim tracing, and competition-specific scoring overlays.
defaultPrompt: Use $mathmodel-studio to open the practical workbench.
Use $mathmodel-studio to compare A/B/C problem choices.
Use $mathmodel-studio to plan and generate paper figures.
Use $mathmodel-studio to review a modeling paper draft.
Use $mathmodel-studio to start an APMCM Chinese contest workflow.
Use $mathmodel-studio to retrieve case and question-level evidence across CUMCM, the graduate contest, and Huashu Cup.
Use $mathmodel-studio to generate a dynamic paper plan and audit every abstract claim.
